source_text: Ὅτε οὖν ἐποίησεν τὴν ἐντολήν, τί λέγει; Τίς ὁ κρινόμενός μοι; ἀντιστήτω μοι: ἡ τίς ὁ δικαιούμενός μοι; ἐγγισάτω τῷ παιδὶ κυρίου. οὐαὶ ὑμῖν, ὅτι ὑμεῖς πάντες ὡς ἱμάτιον παλαιωθήσεσθε, καὶ σὴς καταφάγεται ὑμᾶς. καὶ πάλιν λέγει ὁ προφήτης, ἐπεὶ ὡς λίθος ἰσχυρὸς ἐτέθη εἰς συντριβήν: Ἰδού, ἐμβαλῶ εἰς τὰ θεμέλια Σιὼν λίθον πολυτελῆ, ἐκλεκτόν, ἀκρογωνιαῖον, ἔντιμον. εἶτα τί λέγει; Καὶ ὃς ἐλπίσει ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ζήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα. ἐπὶ λίθον οὖν ἡμῶν ἡ ἐλπίς; μὴ γένοιτο: ἀλλ’ ἐπεὶ ἐν ἰσχύϊ τέθεικεν τὴν σάρκα αὐτοῦ κύριος. λέγει γάρ: Καὶ ἔθηκέ με ὡς στερεὰν πέτραν. λέγει δὲ πάλιν ὁ προφήτης: Λίθον ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες, οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας. καὶ πάλιν λέγει: Αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἡμέρα ἡ μεγάλη καὶ θαυμαστή, ἣν ἐποίησεν ὁ κύριος. ἁπλούστερον ὑμῖν γράφω, ἵνα συνιῆτε: ἐγὼ περίψημα τῆς ἀγάπης ὑμῶν. τί οὗν λέγει πάλιν ὁ προφήτης; Περιέσχεν με συναγωγὴ πονηρευομένων, ἐκύκλωσάν με ὡσεὶ μέλισσαι κηρίον, καί: Ἐπὶ τὸν ἱματισμόν μου ἔβαλον κλῆρον. ἐν σαρκὶ οὖν αὐτοῦ μέλλοντος φανεροῦσθαι καὶ πάσχειν, προεφανερώθη τὸ πάθος. λέγει γὰρ ὁ προφήτης ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραήλ: Οὐαὶ τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτῶν, ὅτι βεβούλευνται βουλὴν πονηρὰν καθ̓ ἑαυτῶν, εἰπόντες: Δήσωμεν τὸν δίκαιον, ὅτι δύσχρηστος ἡμῖν ἐστίν. τί λέγει ὁ ἄλλος προφήτης Μωϋσῆς αὐτοῖς; Ἰδού, τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεός: Εἰσέλθατε εἰς τὴν γῆν τὴν ἀγαθήν, ἣν ὤμοσεν κύριος τῷ Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακώβ, καὶ κατακληρονομήσατε αὐτήν, γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι. τί δὲ λέγει ἡ γνῶσις; μάθετε. ἐλπίσατε, φησίν, ἐπὶ τὸν ἐν σαρκὶ μέλλοντα φανεροῦσθαι ὑμῖν Ἰησοῦν. ἄνθρωπος γὰρ γῆ ἐστιν πάσχουσα: ἀπὸ προσώπου γὰρ τῆς γῆς ἡ πλάσις τοῦ Ἀδὰμ ἐγένετο. τί οὖν λέγει: Εἰς τὴν γῆν τὴν ἀγαθήν, γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι; εὐλογητὸς ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν, ἀδελφοί, ὁ σοφίαν καὶ νοῦν θέμενος ἐν ἡμῖν τῶν κρυφίων αὐτοῦ: λέγει γὰρ ὁ προφήτης παραβολὴν κυρίου: τίς νοήσει, εἰ μὴ σοφὸς καὶ ἐπιστήμων καὶ ἀγαπῶν τὸν κύριον αὐτοῦ; ἐπεὶ οὖν ἀνακαινίσας ἡμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἀφέσει τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν, ἐποίησεν ἡμᾶς ἄλλον τύπον, ὡς παιδίων ἔχειν τὴν ψυχήν, ὡς ἂν δὴ ἀναπλάσσοντος αὐτοῦ ἡμᾶς. λέγει γὰρ ἡ γραφὴ περὶ ἡμῶν, ὡς λέγει τῷ υἱῷ: Ποιήσωμεν κατ’ εἰκόνα καὶ καθ̓ ὁμοίωσιν ἡμῶν τὸν ἄνθρωπον, καὶ ἀρχέτωσαν τῶν θηρίων τῆς γῆς καὶ τῶν πετεινῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τῶν ἰχθύων τῆς θαλάσσης. καὶ εἶπεν κύριος, ἰδὼν τὸ καλὸν πλάσμα ἡμῶν: Λὐξάνεσθε καὶ πληθυνέσθε καὶ πληρώσατε τὴν γῆν. ταῦτα πρὸς τὸν υἱόν. πάλιν σοι ἐπιδείξω, πῶς πρὸς ἡμᾶς λέγει. δευτέραν πλάσιν ἐπ’ ἐσχάτων ἐποίησεν. λέγει δὲ κύριος: Ἰδού, ποιῶ τὰ ἔσχατα ὡς τὰ πρῶτα. εἰς τοῦτο οὖν ἐκήρυξεν ὁ προφήτης: Εἰσέλθατε εἰς γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι καὶ κατακυριεύσατε αὐτῆς. ἴδε οὖν, ἡμεῖς ἀναπεπλάσμεθα, καθὼς πάλιν ἐν ἑτέρῳ προφήτῃ λέγει: Ἰδού, λέγει κύριος, ἐξελῶ τούτων, τουτέστιν ὧν προέβλεπεν τὸ πνεῦμα κυρίου, τὰς λιθίνας καρδίας καὶ ἐμβαλῶ σαρκίνας: ὅτι αὐτὸς ἐν σαρκὶ ἔμελλεν φανεροῦσθαι καὶ ἐν ἡμῖν κατοικεῖν. ναὸς γὰρ ἅγιος, ἀδελφοί μου, τῷ κυρίῳ τὸ κατοικητήριον ἡμῶν τῆς καρδίας. λέγει γὰρ κύριος πάλιν: Καὶ ἐν τίνι ὀφθήσομαι τῷ κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ μου καὶ δοξασθήσομαι; λέγει: Ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ ἀδελφῶν μου, καὶ ψαλῶ σοι ἀνάμεσον ἐκκλησίας ἁγίων. οὐκοῦν ἡμεῖς ἐσμέν, οὕς εἰσήγαγεν εἰς τὴν γῆν τὴν ἀγαθήν. τί οὖν τὸ γάλα καὶ τὸ μέλι; ὅτι πρῶτον τὸ παιδίον μέλιτι, εἶτα γάλακτι ζωοποιεῖται: οὕτως οὖν καὶ ἡμεῖς τῇ πίστει τῆς ἐπαγγελίας καὶ τῷ λόγῳ ζωοποιούμενοι ζήσομεν κατακυριεύοντες τῆς γῆς. προειρήκαμεν δὲ ἐπάνω. Καὶ αὐξανέσθωσαν καὶ πληθυνέσθωσαν καὶ ἀρχέτωσαν τῶν ἰχθύων. τίς οὖν ὁ δυνάμενος νῦν ἄρχειν θηρίων ἤ ἰχθύων ἤ πετεινῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ; αἰσθάνεσθαι γὰρ ὀφείλομεν, ὅτι τὸ ἄρχειν ἐξουσίας ἐστίν, ἵνα τις ἐπιτάξας κυριεύσῃ. εἰ οὖν οὐ γίνεται τοῦτο νῦν, ἄρα ἡμῖν εἴρηκεν, πότε: ὅταν καὶ αὐτοὶ τελειωθῶμεν κληρονόμοι τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου γενέσθαι.
pass_a_gloss: When therefore he made the command, what does he say? Who is the one being judged by me? Let him stand against me: or who is the one being justified by me? Let him draw near to the child of the Lord. Woe to you, because you all will be worn out like a garment, and a moth will eat you. And again the prophet says, since he was placed as a strong stone for crushing: Behold, I will throw into the foundations of Zion a precious stone, chosen, a cornerstone, honorable. Then what does he say? And the one who hopes in him will live forever. Is our hope therefore in a stone? May it not be: but since the Lord placed his flesh in strength. For he says: And he placed me as a solid rock. And the prophet says again: A stone which the builders rejected, this one became the head of the corner. And again he says: This is the great and wonderful day which the Lord made. I write to you more simply, so that you may understand: I am the remains of your love. What then does the prophet say again? A crowd of evil-doers surrounded me, they encircled me like bees around a honeycomb, and: They cast lots for my clothing. Therefore, when he was about to appear and suffer in the flesh, his passion was revealed beforehand. For the prophet says about Israel: Woe to their soul, because they have decided a wicked plan against themselves, saying: Let us bind the just one, because he is troublesome to us. What does the other prophet Moses say to them? Behold, the Lord God says these things: Enter into the good land which the Lord swore to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, and inherit it, a land flowing with milk and honey. What does knowledge say? Learn. Hope, he says, in the one who is about to appear to you in the flesh, Jesus. For a man is earth suffering: for from the face of the earth the creation of Adam came about. What then does he say: Into the good land, a land flowing with milk and honey? Blessed is our Lord, brothers, who puts wisdom and understanding in us of his secrets: for the prophet says a parable of the Lord: Who will understand, if not the wise and knowledgeable and loving his Lord? Since therefore he has renewed us in the forgiveness of sins, he made us another type, as having the soul of children, as if he were remolding us. For the scripture says about us, as he says to the Son: Let us make man according to our image and likeness, and let them rule over the beasts of the earth and the birds of the sky and the fish of the sea. And the Lord said, seeing our good creation: Increase and multiply and fill the earth. These things to the Son. Again I will show you how he speaks to us. He made a second creation in the last times. And the Lord says: Behold, I will make the last things as the first. Therefore the prophet proclaimed: Enter into the land flowing with milk and honey and take possession of it. See therefore, we have been remolded, as again another prophet says: Behold, the Lord says, I will remove from these, that is, from those which the spirit of the Lord foresaw, the stony hearts and I will put in fleshly ones: because he himself was about to appear in the flesh and dwell in us. For the holy temple, brothers, is the dwelling place of our heart for the Lord. For the Lord says again: And in what will I appear to the Lord my God and be glorified? He says: I will confess to you in the church of my brothers, and I will sing to you among the church of the holy ones. Therefore we are the ones whom he led into the good land. What then is the milk and the honey? Because first the child is nourished with honey, then with milk: thus also we, being nourished with the faith of the promise and the word, will live ruling over the earth. But we said above: And let them increase and multiply and rule over the fish. Who then is able to rule now over the beasts or the fish or the birds of the sky? For we ought to perceive that ruling is a matter of authority, so that someone, having commanded, may rule. If therefore this does not happen now, then he told us when: when we also will have been perfected to become heirs of the Lord's covenant.

to indicate the object of hope

choices.why: to describe the process of spiritual renewal

pass_b_english: When he carried out the command, what does he say? "Who is the one judging me? Let him stand against me. Who is the one justifying me? Let him draw near to the Lord's child." Woe to you, because you will all wear out like a garment, and a moth will consume you. The prophet speaks again, because he was set as a strong stone for crushing: "See, I am laying in Zion's foundations a precious, chosen, honored cornerstone" (Isaiah 28:16). Then what does he say? "The one who hopes in him will live forever." Is our hope therefore in a stone? Absolutely not; rather, because the Lord placed his flesh in strength. For he says, "He set me like a solid rock." And the prophet says again: "The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone" (Psalm 118:22). And again: "This is the great and wonderful day the Lord has made." I am writing more plainly so you can understand: I am the remnant of your love. What does the prophet say once more? "A gang of evildoers hemmed me in; they swarmed around me like bees around a honeycomb, and they cast lots for my clothing." Because he was about to appear and suffer in the flesh, his passion was foretold. The prophet says concerning Israel: "Woe to their souls, for they have plotted a wicked scheme against themselves, saying, 'Let us bind the righteous one, because he is troublesome to us.'" What does the other prophet Moses say to them? "This is what the Lord God says: 'Enter the good land the Lord swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and take possession of it — a land flowing with milk and honey.'" What does knowledge say? "Learn. Hope, he says, in the one about to be revealed to you in the flesh — Jesus." For a human being is suffering earth; from the face of the earth the formation of Adam came about. So what does "Enter the good land, a land flowing with milk and honey" mean? Blessed is our Lord, brothers, who puts wisdom and understanding of his secrets within us. The prophet speaks a parable of the Lord: "Who will understand, if not the wise, the knowledgeable, and the one who loves his Lord?" Since he has renewed us through the forgiveness of sins, he has made us a new kind of people — having the souls of children, as if he were reshaping us. Scripture says about us, as he says to the Son: "Let us make humanity in our image and likeness, and let them rule over the beasts of the earth, the birds of the sky, and the fish of the sea" (Genesis 1:26-28). And the Lord said, seeing his good creation: "Increase, multiply, and fill the earth." These words are addressed to the Son. I will show you again how he speaks to us. He made a second creation in the last days. And the Lord says: "See, I make the last things like the first." That is why the prophet proclaimed: "Enter the land flowing with milk and honey and take possession of it." See, then, we have been reshaped, just as another prophet says: "See, says the Lord, I will remove from these — that is, from those the Spirit of the Lord foresaw — the stony hearts and put in hearts of flesh, because he himself was about to appear in the flesh and dwell in us." For the holy temple, brothers, is the dwelling place of our heart for the Lord. The Lord says again: "In what will I appear to the Lord my God and be glorified?" He says: "I will confess you in the assembly of my brothers, and sing to you in the midst of the assembly of the holy ones." Therefore we are the ones he led into the good land. What, then, are the milk and honey? Because first a child is nourished with honey, then with milk; so also we, being nourished by the faith of the promise and the word, will live ruling over the earth. We said this above: "And let them increase, multiply, and rule over the fish." Who, then, is able now to rule over beasts, fish, or birds of the sky? We must recognize that ruling is a matter of authority, so that someone, having commanded, may rule. If this does not happen now, then he told us when: when we too have been perfected to become heirs of the Lord's covenant.

review.notes: The translation accurately captures the nuances of the Greek text, including the distinction between 'being judged' (κρινόμενός) and 'being justified' (δικαιούμενός), and the complex metaphor of the 'remains/remnant of your love' (περίψημα τῆς ἀγάπης ὑμῶν). Scripture citations in Pass B are correctly identified and added as per instructions.
